arc.howTo: Click the start, the end, then a point the arc passes through
arc.name: Arc

circle.howTo: Drag out from the centre, or click the centre and then the rim
circle.name: Circle

hardware.howTo: Click to punch a hole in the selected part, at the size chosen above
hardware.name: Hardware

line.howTo: Drag end to end, or click both ends · Shift holds 15° steps
line.name: Line

measure.howTo: Click two corners to dimension the distance between them
measure.name: Measure

points.howTo: Drag a point of the selected drawn path to move it · press an edge to add one · Del removes the point last pressed · R rounds that corner, or sharpens a rounded one
points.name: Edit Points

polyline.howTo: Click each point · A arcs the next segment: click its end, then a point on it · L goes straight · click the first to close · Enter finishes · Backspace takes one back
polyline.name: Polyline

rectangle.howTo: Drag corner to corner, or click both corners · Shift keeps it square
rectangle.name: Rectangle

rotate.howTo: Drag around the selection to turn it about its centre
rotate.name: Rotate

scale.howTo: Drag to resize the selection about its centre · Shift holds the proportions
scale.name: Scale

select.howTo: Click to select · Shift-click adds or removes · drag on empty space to box-select · drag a selection to move it · Del removes
select.name: Select

text.howTo: Click to place a label on the selected part, then type it in the panel
text.name: Text

properties.addAllowanceHint: The cut edge, that far outside this seam — and it follows the seam's shape
properties.addHolesHint: Holes along this line, at the pitch of your iron
properties.addStitchLineHint: A stitch line that follows this edge at a fixed margin, and keeps following it
properties.foldMirrorHint: A counterpart across {{fold}}, which re-mirrors whenever that fold moves
properties.frozenNote: Frozen from {{source}}: drawn geometry now, no longer following it.
properties.lockedNote: Locked, so nothing here can be changed. Unlock it in the parts panel.
properties.manySelected_one: {{count}} feature selected. Editing more than one at a time comes later.
properties.manySelected_other: {{count}} features selected. Editing more than one at a time comes later.
properties.mirrorFoldNote: Mirrors {{source}} across {{fold}}. Move that fold and this follows it; move {{source}} and this stays its mirror. It cannot be dragged on its own.
properties.mirrorLineNote: Mirrors {{source}} across a line fixed where this was made — it does not follow {{source}} about. Moving {{source}} moves this the opposite way, and resizing it changes the gap between the two. Drag this piece to place the pair.
properties.name: Name
properties.nothingSelected: Nothing selected. Draw with R, or pick something with V.
properties.title: Properties

flipHint.horizontal: Turn it over left to right, about its own centre. Nothing stays linked.
flipHint.vertical: Turn it over top to bottom, about its own centre. Nothing stays linked.

counterpart.horizontal: A counterpart to the right, mirrored across this piece's right edge as it is now. It keeps following this piece's shape; the mirror line stays where it is put.
counterpart.vertical: A counterpart below, mirrored across this piece's bottom edge as it is now. It keeps following this piece's shape; the mirror line stays where it is put.

piece.horizontal: A mirrored piece, as a new part, to the right, mirrored across this piece's right edge as it is now. It keeps following this piece's shape; the mirror line stays where it is put.
piece.vertical: A mirrored piece, as a new part, below, mirrored across this piece's bottom edge as it is now. It keeps following this piece's shape; the mirror line stays where it is put.

properties.manyPartsSelected_one: {{count}} part selected. Editing more than one at a time comes later.
properties.manyPartsSelected_other: {{count}} parts selected. Editing more than one at a time comes later.

SOURCE_MISSING.title: Follows nothing
SOURCE_MISSING.description: {{featureName}} follows a feature that does not exist.

WOULD_LOOP.title: Would loop
WOULD_LOOP.description: {{featureName}} would end up following itself, through {{sourceName}}.

CYCLE.title: Follows itself
CYCLE.description: {{featureName}} follows a chain that leads back to itself.

rule.allowance-needs-closed-line: A seam allowance needs a closed stitch line: an outline has to enclose the part.
rule.allowance-needs-outer: Only a part's outer outline can be derived from its stitch line, not a cut-out.
rule.allowance-needs-outline: Only an outline can be offset outward from a stitch line.
rule.allowance-needs-stitch-line: An outline can only be offset outward from a stitch line.
rule.allowance-needs-whole-run: A seam allowance follows the whole stitch line, so the outline it makes is closed.
rule.holes-need-hole-set: Only a stitch hole set can follow a stitch line at a pitch.
rule.holes-need-stitch-line: Holes can only follow a stitch line.
rule.inset-needs-outline: A stitch line can only be inset from an outline or a cut-out.
rule.inset-needs-stitch-line: Only a stitch line can be inset from an outline.
rule.mirror-keeps-kind: A counterpart is the same kind of thing as what it mirrors.
rule.mirror-keeps-role: A mirrored cut contour stays what it was: an outline mirrors to an outline, a cut-out to a cut-out.

PART_ALREADY_HAS_OUTER.title: Already has an outline
PART_ALREADY_HAS_OUTER.description: {{partName}} is already cut to {{outerName}}. A part is one piece of leather, so it has one outline — draw this as a cut-out, or start another part.

CONTOUR_NOT_CLOSED.title: Does not enclose anything
CONTOUR_NOT_CLOSED.inner: {{subject}} has two ends, so there is nothing to cut out of the part. Draw it as a marking line.
CONTOUR_NOT_CLOSED.innerClosable: {{subject}} has two ends, so there is nothing to cut out of the part. Close the shape, or draw it as a marking line.
CONTOUR_NOT_CLOSED.outer: {{subject}} has two ends, so there is nothing to cut out. Draw it as a marking line.
CONTOUR_NOT_CLOSED.outerClosable: {{subject}} has two ends, so there is nothing to cut out. Close the shape, or draw it as a marking line.

MEASURE_REF_MISSING.title: Measures nothing
MEASURE_REF_MISSING.description: {{featureName}} names a place that is no longer in the drawing.

MEASURE_NEEDS_ANCHOR.title: Nothing to measure from
MEASURE_NEEDS_ANCHOR.description: A dimension has to name a corner, so it keeps meaning the same place when the drawing changes. Point at one.

MEASURE_ACROSS_PARTS.title: A dimension measures one piece
MEASURE_ACROSS_PARTS.description: That corner is on {{otherPartName}}. A dimension prints with the piece it measures, so both of its ends have to be on that piece.

FOLLOWS_ANOTHER_PART.title: On another piece
FOLLOWS_ANOTHER_PART.description: {{sourceName}} is on {{otherPartName}}, so {{featureName}} would be drawn there and print with the wrong piece. Follow something on this piece.

MIRROR_FOLD_MISSING.title: The fold is gone
MIRROR_FOLD_MISSING.description: {{featureName}} is mirrored across a fold that no longer exists.

MIRROR_OUTLINE_ACROSS_FOLD.title: A piece has one edge
MIRROR_OUTLINE_ACROSS_FOLD.description: Mirroring across a fold is for what is *inside* a piece — slots, stitching, hardware. {{partName}} already has an outline, and a piece of leather has one edge, so its contour cannot be completed this way. Draw the whole outline, or mirror the part to make a second piece.

MIRROR_PLACED_BY_FOLD.title: Placed by its fold
MIRROR_PLACED_BY_FOLD.description: {{featureName}} is mirrored across {{foldName}}, so it goes where the fold puts it. Move {{foldName}}, or move {{sourceName}}.

FOLD_NOT_STRAIGHT.title: The fold is not straight
FOLD_NOT_STRAIGHT.description: A mirror needs one line to fold about, and this fold bends. Draw it as a straight crease, or mirror across a different one.

MIRROR_WOULD_SCALE.title: A counterpart cannot be resized
MIRROR_WOULD_SCALE.description: {{featureName}} is a mirror of {{sourceName}}, so it is the size {{sourceName}} is. Scale {{sourceName}} and this follows.

MIRROR_NO_AXIS.title: Nothing to mirror across
MIRROR_NO_AXIS.description: Select something with a size to it, and the mirror runs along its edge.

FEATURE_LOCKED.title: Locked
FEATURE_LOCKED.description: {{featureName}} is locked, so it cannot be changed or deleted. Unlock it in the parts panel first.

NOT_A_DRAWN_PATH.title: No points to edit
NOT_A_DRAWN_PATH.description: {{featureName}} is not a drawn path, so it has no points of its own. A shape is changed by its measurements, and a derived feature follows what it was made from.

POINT_EDIT_DEGENERATE.title: Too few points
POINT_EDIT_DEGENERATE.description: That would leave {{featureName}} with too few points, or a side of no length.

ROUNDING_DOES_NOT_FIT.title: The rounding does not fit
ROUNDING_DOES_NOT_FIT.description: A {{radius}} mm rounding does not fit that point of {{featureName}}: it has to be a corner between two straight sides, each longer than the rounding takes.

NOT_A_ROUNDED_CORNER.title: Nothing to sharpen
NOT_A_ROUNDED_CORNER.description: That is not a rounded corner between two straight sides of {{featureName}}, so there is no corner to sharpen it back to.

CORNER_IN_USE.title: A corner in use
CORNER_IN_USE.description: {{usedByName}} is attached to that corner of {{featureName}}, and this edit would take the corner away. Change {{usedByName}} first.

NOT_DERIVED.title: Follows nothing
NOT_DERIVED.description: {{featureName}} does not follow anything, so there is nothing to re-point.

DERIVED_MOVED_ALONE.title: Moves with its source
DERIVED_MOVED_ALONE.description: {{featureName}} follows {{rootName}}, so it moves when {{rootName}} does. Move {{rootName}} instead.

TRANSFORM_FLATTENS.title: Would flatten
TRANSFORM_FLATTENS.description: That would flatten the shape to nothing.

WOULD_BECOME_ELLIPSE.title: Would become an ellipse
WOULD_BECOME_ELLIPSE.description: A circle or arc cannot survive a non-uniform scale — it would become an ellipse, which this editor cannot represent. Scale it evenly instead.

WOULD_SHEAR.title: Would shear
WOULD_SHEAR.description: A turned rectangle cannot be stretched along one axis — it would shear, and its corners would stop being square. Rotate it back to 0°, or scale it evenly.

TEXT_WOULD_DISTORT.title: Would distort the letters
TEXT_WOULD_DISTORT.description: Text can only be scaled evenly — stretching it along one axis would distort the letters. Hold Shift, or set the size in the panel.

DIMENSION_NOT_MIRRORED.title: A dimension is measured, not mirrored
DIMENSION_NOT_MIRRORED.description: {{featureName}} measures the drawing, so a mirrored copy would quote a number that is not the counterpart's. Mirror the shapes, then measure the counterpart.

TEXT_WOULD_READ_BACKWARDS.title: Would read backwards
TEXT_WOULD_READ_BACKWARDS.description: A label cannot be mirrored — it would read backwards. Flip the shapes and leave the words, or retype them where you want them.

NO_TARGET_PART.title: No part selected
NO_TARGET_PART.cut-out: Select a part first — a cut-out belongs to the panel it is drawn on.
NO_TARGET_PART.label: Select a part first — a label belongs to the panel it is drawn on.
NO_TARGET_PART.line: Select a part first — a fold or marking line belongs to the panel it is drawn on.

TARGET_SPANS_PARTS.title: Selection spans parts
TARGET_SPANS_PARTS.description: Select one part: this belongs to a single panel, and the selection spans more than one.

PARAMETER_INVALID.title: Unusable number
PARAMETER_INVALID.at-least: {{featureName}}'s {{parameter}} is below {{minimum}}, the smallest that can be used. Type at least {{minimum}}.
PARAMETER_INVALID.finite: {{featureName}}'s {{parameter}} is not a usable number. Type a value in millimetres.
PARAMETER_INVALID.non-negative: {{featureName}}'s {{parameter}} is {{value}}, and it must not be negative.
PARAMETER_INVALID.positive: {{featureName}}'s {{parameter}} is {{value}}, and it must be more than zero.

OFFSET_COLLAPSED.title: Offset collapsed
OFFSET_COLLAPSED.inward: A {{distance}} mm edge margin is deeper than this edge can hold.
OFFSET_COLLAPSED.outward: A {{distance}} mm allowance cannot be built outside this stitch line.

OFFSET_UNSUPPORTED.title: Cannot offset curves
OFFSET_UNSUPPORTED.description: {{featureName}} cannot be built: what it follows has free-form curves, and an offset cannot follow those yet.

OFFSET_SPLIT.title: Offset came apart
OFFSET_SPLIT.description_one: The offset for {{featureName}} came apart into {{pieces}} pieces. Only the largest is drawn; {{count}} piece left out.
OFFSET_SPLIT.description_other: The offset for {{featureName}} came apart into {{pieces}} pieces. Only the largest is drawn; {{count}} pieces left out.

ANCHOR_MISSING.title: Corner not found
ANCHOR_MISSING.description: That run named corner {{anchor}}, and this outline has {{available}}.
ANCHOR_MISSING.noCorners: This outline has no corners to run between, so it can only be followed whole.

SOURCE_FAILED.title: Source failed
SOURCE_FAILED.description: The {{sourceName}} it follows could not be built.

TEXT_GLYPH_MISSING.title: Cannot be printed
TEXT_GLYPH_MISSING.label: “{{text}}” uses {{characters}}, which this typeface cannot print — it comes out as a box. Retype the label using Latin characters.
TEXT_GLYPH_MISSING.part: “{{text}}” uses {{characters}}, which this typeface cannot print — it comes out as a box. Rename the part using Latin characters.

CONTOUR_SELF_INTERSECTS.title: Outline crosses itself
CONTOUR_SELF_INTERSECTS.description_one: {{featureName}} crosses itself once, so where to cut is ambiguous. Redraw it so the line never crosses.
CONTOUR_SELF_INTERSECTS.description_other: {{featureName}} crosses itself {{count}} times, so where to cut is ambiguous. Redraw it so the line never crosses.

HOLE_SPACING_DEVIATION.title: Spacing off the iron
HOLE_SPACING_DEVIATION.description: The spacing came out {{achieved}} against a {{pitch}} iron. Change the pitch, or the edge margin, to bring them together.

HOLE_SPACING_UNEVEN.title: Uneven spacing
HOLE_SPACING_UNEVEN.description: The runs of {{featureName}} are spaced from {{narrowest}} to {{widest}}, so the change will show at the corners.

HOLE_COUNT_TOO_LOW.title: Too few holes
HOLE_COUNT_TOO_LOW.description_one: {{featureName}} has {{count}} hole, and a seam needs at least two.
HOLE_COUNT_TOO_LOW.description_other: {{featureName}} has {{count}} holes, and a seam needs at least two.
HOLE_COUNT_TOO_LOW.none: {{featureName}} has no holes, and a seam needs at least two.

PART_HAS_NO_OUTER_CONTOUR.title: Nothing to cut
PART_HAS_NO_OUTER_CONTOUR.description: {{partName}} has stitching and marks but no outline, so there is no piece of leather to cut them from. Draw an outline, or move these onto another part.

CUT_OUT_OUTSIDE_PART.title: Cut-out is off the part
CUT_OUT_OUTSIDE_PART.description: {{featureName}} is not inside the outline it belongs to, so it cuts nothing. Move it onto the part.

OUTSIDE_PART.title: Off the material
OUTSIDE_PART.holes: {{featureName}} has holes off the material — through the outline, or into a cut-out. They cannot be punched.
OUTSIDE_PART.line: {{featureName}} runs off the material, so part of it cannot be marked.

HOLE_TOO_CLOSE_TO_EDGE.title: Too near the edge
HOLE_TOO_CLOSE_TO_EDGE.description: {{featureName}} comes within {{clearance}} of an edge, under the {{minimum}} a stitch needs. Leather tears out between a hole and an edge.

EMPTY_PART.title: Empty part
EMPTY_PART.description: {{partName}} has nothing in it. Draw into it, or remove it from the parts list.

WHOLE_PART_NOT_SCALED.title: A whole part is not scaled
WHOLE_PART_NOT_SCALED.description: Scale resizes the shapes you pick, not a whole part: that would resize its rivet holes and labels too. Pick its outline on the board to resize the edge alone.

contextMenu.hideNote: Also left off the PDF until shown again
contextMenu.label: Selection
contextMenu.spansParts_one: The selection is in {{count}} part; duplicate one at a time
contextMenu.spansParts_other: The selection is in {{count}} parts; duplicate one at a time

editor.drawnByHand: Drawn by hand, so it has points rather than measurements. Move, add or remove them with Edit Points (N).
